property_summary: For every non-empty _tos array, C.transfer must call the callee for each element (so the callee's recorded call count equals _tos.length); the mutant that starts loop at i=1 will make one fewer call for some inputs (when _tos.length>0), breaking that rule.
change_summary: Invert the loop condition so the for-loop runs zero times (i starts at 1), causing no external calls and making transfer always return true when original might have performed calls — observable difference when _tos non-empty.
